title: Grade 2 French — Thu, Jun 19
description: Adjectif agreement — Day 4 of 5: Colour adjectives agree with the noun
subject: french

questions.question: In French, colour adjectives change depending on the ___ of the noun.
questions.explanation: Colour adjectives agree in gender (masculine/feminine) with the noun they describe. 'Un t-shirt rouge' (m) / 'une robe rouge' (f) — 'rouge' doesn't change, but other colours do.

questions.question: What is the feminine form of 'blanc' (white)?
What is the feminine form of 'noir' (black)?
questions.explanation: 'Noir' (masculine) → 'noire' (feminine). Add '-e'. 'Un chat noir' but 'une robe noire'.

questions.question: Which colours are the SAME for masculine AND feminine?
options: Rouge, orange, jaune, rose, violet (when no change)
questions.explanation: Some colours like 'rouge', 'orange', 'rose' don't change form. But 'blanc→blanche', 'vert→verte', 'bleu→bleue' do change.

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: 'a red dress'
questions.explanation: 'Une robe rouge' = a red dress. 'Rouge' doesn't change for feminine. 'Robe' = feminine → 'une'.

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: 'a white shirt'
questions.explanation: 'Une chemise blanche' = a white shirt. 'Chemise' is feminine → 'une' + 'blanche' (feminine form of blanc).

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: 'a black hat'
questions.explanation: 'Un chapeau noir' = a black hat. 'Chapeau' = masculine → 'un' + 'noir' (masculine form stays the same).

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: 'a green skirt'
questions.explanation: 'Une jupe verte' = a green skirt. 'Jupe' = feminine → 'une' + 'verte' (feminine form of vert).

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: 'a blue coat'
questions.explanation: 'Un manteau bleu' = a blue coat. 'Manteau' = masculine → 'un' + 'bleu' (masculine form).

questions.question: Describe: 'Elle porte une robe ___.' (She wears a yellow dress.)
questions.explanation: 'Jaune' = yellow. 'Jaune' does not change for feminine — it stays 'jaune'. 'Elle porte une robe jaune.'

questions.question: Describe: 'Il porte un pull ___.' (He wears a grey sweater.)
questions.explanation: 'Gris' = grey (masculine). 'Un pull' is masculine → use 'gris'. 'Il porte un pull gris.'

questions.question: Which sentence has CORRECT adjective agreement?
options: Il porte un t-shirt rouge et elle porte une jupe verte.
questions.explanation: 'Il porte un t-shirt rouge et elle porte une jupe verte.' Rouge = no change; verte = feminine form of vert. Correct!

questions.question: CHALLENGE: Describe your favourite outfit: 'Je porte ___ et ___.' (2 items with colour adjectives)
options: Je porte un t-shirt rouge et un pantalon noir.
Je portes t-shirt rouge et pantalon noir.
Je porte rouge un t-shirt et noir un pantalon.
questions.explanation: 'Je porte un t-shirt rouge et un pantalon noir.' Correct word order: article + noun + adjective. Well done!
